findings.impact: The progress receipt lists preregistration as a cleared gate even though the corrected residual-batch record explicitly says its thresholds and observations were committed together and are not preregistered. This promotes retrospective development evidence into a cleared validation gate and makes the status ledger internally false.
findings.minimal_fix: Remove preregistration from gates_cleared or rename it to an explicitly retrospective development-decision gate.

findings.impact: The manifest leaves complexitySha256 null while promising that the deterministic-preflight identity is in an immutable release receipt; the committed delivery receipt records artifact hashes and a publication commit but no preflight complexity hash. Consequently PREFLIGHT_CLEAN is not bound to the reviewed artifact identity as claimed.
findings.minimal_fix: Record the actual deterministic-preflight complexity SHA-256 in the manifest or immutable delivery receipt and update the corresponding identity-location statement.
